text:
Nina: Quick idea 1: run a compact PLG experiment: 30-min "Quickstart Lab" webinar + 35 starter credits + 3 bite-sized prompt templates. Hypothesis: combo reduces time-to-first-success and boosts week-1 engagement.
Rory: Agree. Define primary metric: percent of new accounts with >=1 successful generation within 24h and TTFS <= 10m. Secondary: gen_count_7d, retention_d7.
Jamal: Cohorts = control | credits_only | webinar_only | combo. Power look: baseline ~11%, target +20% rel -> ~1.5k per arm for 80% power. If low traffic, run over 4 weeks.
Clara: Landing + RSVP will be main channel; add small paid push to developer Slack groups. CTA text test: "Reserve seat + claim credits" vs "Try now  get starter credits".
PromoBot: Promo pool created: quickstart_pool (2500 codes). API: POST /assign?pool=quickstart_pool&user_id=... -> {code,expires_at}. Codes single-use, expiry 14 days.
Nina: Prompt templates: "Cold outreach (short)"; "Product idea brainstorm"; "SQL->insights". Keep examples runnable and low-token.
Rory: Include micro-bench slide: tokens/cost/latency for each template. Request latest numbers from eng-runtime.
Jamal: Tracking: utm_source, arm, promo_code, webinar_reg, first_gen_ts, gen_count_24h, ttfs. QA: validate with 2 test accounts before launch.
Clara: Owners: Rory-land + social narratives; Jamal-metrics + analysis plan; PromoBot/Infra - code assignment; Nina - webinar script & templates. Drafts by Thu EOD. Weekly check Mon 9am PT.
Nina: Also add inline one-click "try sample" on landing; falls back to curl snippet if not logged in. Lowers friction.
Rory: I'll draft the social benchmark narrative: "how we shortened time-to-first-prompt" and a PM variant.
Clara: Great. I'll compile the experiment brief and post link when ready. :rocket:
